Choose one adjacent unattended door, lid or movable obstacle. Prepare the obstacle with your lever and wedges. The next Force roll by you or an ally to open, close or move it gains 2 Boons. Choose the intended task when preparing it.

Rules

Action
Maneuver
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
One adjacent unattended door, lid or movable obstacle.
Equipment / acquisition
A lever and wedges (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Limits
One prepared obstacle at a time; benefit lasts one minute or until used.
Type
Skill / Utility
